description: Image Description: The image contains a single mathematical symbol, specifically the plus sign (+). It is centered in the frame and appears in a simple, bold, black font against a plain white background. The plus sign consists of two intersecting lines of equal length, one horizontal and one vertical, forming a cross shape. There are no additional objects, textures, or elements present in the image. The overall composition is minimalistic and focused solely on the representation of the plus symbol.
